hypotheses.E0_full_degree_recomposition_is_exact: Degree 0 through 32 recompose the direct semantic product gradient with cosine at least 0.999 and relative error at most 0.02 at every site.
hypotheses.E1_degree4_is_useful: The cumulative degree-4 program reaches at least 0.70 median gradient cosine.
hypotheses.E2_degree8_is_high_fidelity: The cumulative degree-8 program reaches at least 0.90 median gradient cosine.
hypotheses.E3_degree8_preserves_contributions: After multiplication by the exact donor activation delta, degree 8 reaches at least 0.85 median contribution cosine.
hypotheses.E4_degree8_preserves_sparse_leverage: Degree-8-selected top-64 positive channels retain at least 80% of exact first-order leverage in the median.
hypotheses.E5_degree8_transfers_across_features: Every one of the eight semantic features has median degree-8 gradient cosine at least 0.80.
